sentences.en: And was he allowed to carry a gun where he was by law?
sentences.zh: 那么他当时在法律上被允许在他所在的地方带枪吗？

sentences.en: Yes, he was.
sentences.zh: 是的，允许。

sentences.en: Cash Patel, the FBI director, was clearly wrong about stating what he stated.
sentences.zh: FBI局长卡什·帕特尔在发表相关言论时明显说错了。

sentences.en: Kristi Noem was clearly wrong about stating what she stated.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂·诺姆在发表相关言论时也明显说错了。

sentences.en: The fact that they play so fast and loose with making statements like that, when they were clearly wrong, says, yes,
sentences.zh: 他们对于发表这种言论显得如此草率，而他们明明大错特错，这就说明，是的，

sentences.en: the Second Amendment is in danger of being violated by this administration.
sentences.zh: 第二修正案正面临被本届政府侵犯的危险。

sentences.en: Now, was it smart that Alex Petty was armed while he was doing what he was doing?
sentences.zh: 话说回来，亚历克斯·佩蒂在做他当时所做的事情时随身携带武器，这明智吗？

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，一点也不明智。

sentences.en: It was a very, very, very poor life choice that certainly contributed to him getting killed.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常非常糟糕的人生选择，这绝对是他丧命的原因之一。

sentences.en: There's no question about that.
sentences.zh: 这是毫无疑问的。

sentences.en: Does what happened to Petty, does that video change in any way, the way that you think about the Trump administration and its enforcement of immigration policies?
sentences.zh: 佩蒂身上发生的事情，那段视频，有没有在任何方面改变你对特朗普政府及其移民政策执行力度的看法？

sentences.en: I would say that the way that these policies are being enforced or were, I think Tom Homan actually introduces a level of calm and consideration that wasn't there before.
sentences.zh: 我想说，对于这些政策的执行方式——或者说过去的执行方式，我认为汤姆·霍曼其实带来了一种以前所没有的冷静和慎重。

sentences.en: But the way that they were being enforced was all wrong.
sentences.zh: 但它们过去的执行方式完全是错的。

sentences.en: Conservatives are supposed to be, in my opinion, suspect of government force and the government's sole role is to protect the individual from undue force and fraud.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，保守派本该对政府权力抱有戒心，而政府唯一的职责就是保护个人免受不当强权和欺诈的侵害。

sentences.en: I was definitely seeing an element of undue force being perpetrated by the federal government, which I'm 100 percent againSt.
sentences.zh: 我确实看到了联邦政府正在施加不当强权的一个因素，对此我一百万个反对。

sentences.en: When they begin to use undue force on the citizens of this country, it changes the dynamic of that relationship.
sentences.zh: 当他们开始对这个国家的公民使用不当强权时，这种关系的动态就变了。

sentences.en: And it's a very, very, very big deal.
sentences.zh: 这可是一件非常非常非常大的事。

sentences.en: And what were your views on mass deportations before, like the goal, and have they changed in the past year and also in the past week?
sentences.zh: 那你以前对大规模驱逐出境的看法是什么，比如目标是什么，过去一年以及过去一周里这些看法有没有改变？

sentences.en: So my opinion of mass deportations and the idea that we need to deport people who are in this country illegally has not changed.
sentences.zh: 所以我对大规模驱逐出境的看法，以及我们需要驱逐非法在美人员的想法，并没有改变。

sentences.en: Not because of this event, not because of what's happening in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 不是因为这次事件，也不是因为明尼苏达州正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Just because the way that something is being implemented, in my opinion, is egregious, it's just terribly ineffective and incompetent,
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为某件事的实施方式在我看来极其恶劣，简直是极度低效和无能，

sentences.en: does not change the fact that I think that the thing itself is still the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 但这并不改变我认为这件事本身依然是正确做法的事实。

sentences.en: So is it fair to say that President Trump still has your support, but they need to do better?
sentences.zh: 那么，这样说是否公平：特朗普总统仍然得到你的支持，但他们需要做得更好？

sentences.en: I would say that the Constitution has my support.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，宪法得到了我的支持。

sentences.en: I mean, there are still some things that the Trump administration is doing that I fully support.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特朗普政府现在做的一些事情我仍然完全支持。

sentences.en: And the only thing that I can say in terms of continuing to support this administration is if Kamala Harris had won the election,
sentences.zh: 如果非要说我为什么继续支持本届政府，我只能说，如果卡玛拉·哈里斯赢了这场大选，

sentences.en: I don't think anything that I wanted would have been accomplished at this point.
sentences.zh: 我想我所期望的任何事情在现阶段都不会实现。

sentences.en: And probably even made several things worse.
sentences.zh: 而且可能还会把好几件事情搞得更糟。

sentences.en: So there's that.
sentences.zh: 所以情况就是这样。

sentences.en: I'm still at least this way getting something.
sentences.zh: 至少用这种方式我还能得到一些东西。

sentences.en: But we still have a really, really, really big problem with an administration that doesn't seem to have a lot of regard for the First Amendment, the Second Amendment,
sentences.zh: 但我们仍然面临一个非常非常大的问题，那就是一个似乎对第一修正案、第二修正案、

sentences.en: the Fourth Amendment, and probably several others.
sentences.zh: 第四修正案以及可能其他好几项修正案都不怎么放在眼里的政府。

sentences.en: Let's be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说吧。

sentences.en: It's problematic.
sentences.zh: 这很有问题。

sentences.en: Recent polling shows that about 30 percent of Republicans think immigration enforcement tactics have gone too far.
sentences.zh: 最近的民调显示，大约30%的共和党人认为移民执法手段走得太远了。

sentences.en: But the vast majority say it's either on track or needs to go even further.
sentences.zh: 但绝大多数人认为要么正走在正轨上，要么还需要进一步加大力度。

sentences.en: Looking at how the Trump administration is currently pursuing mass deportations, is there anything you would do differently?
sentences.zh: 纵观特朗普政府目前推行的大规模驱逐行动，你有什么做法会跟他们不一样吗？

sentences.en: As far as the Trump administration goes, no, not really.
sentences.zh: 就特朗普政府而言，没有，真的没有。

sentences.en: He's doing all the things that he...
sentences.zh: 他正在做所有那些他……

sentences.en: I think that's exactly what I voted for.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是我投票支持他的原因。

sentences.en: So to sit back and complain that he's doing those things now is kind of stupid, if you ask me.
sentences.zh: 所以坐在那里抱怨他现在在做这些事情，依我看有点愚蠢。

sentences.en: If you voted for him, you need to be supporting him all the way.
sentences.zh: 如果你投票支持了他，你就得一路支持到底。

sentences.en: My problem isn't with the deportations.
sentences.zh: 我的问题不在于驱逐出境本身。

sentences.en: My problem is that these so-called protesters are instigating like they want stuff like this to happen.
sentences.zh: 我的问题是，这些所谓的抗议者在煽动事端，好像他们巴不得发生这种事一样。

sentences.en: It's one thing to stand on the street and make your voice heard.
sentences.zh: 站在街头发出你的声音是一回事。

sentences.en: It's another thing to get in the middle of those guys doing their job and stand in their way.
sentences.zh: 跑到那些正在干活的人中间去挡他们的道则是另一回事。

sentences.en: You show up with a weapon?
sentences.zh: 你带着武器出现？

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 那对不起了。

sentences.en: They're going to use force.
sentences.zh: 他们是要动用武力的。

sentences.en: I know this sounds very harsh, but you play stupid games, you win stupid prizes.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来很刺耳，但不作死就不会死。

sentences.en: You know, you make stupid choices, you get stupid consequences.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，做出愚蠢的选择，就会承担愚蠢的后果。

sentences.en: I still support the deportation policy.
sentences.zh: 我仍然支持驱逐政策。

sentences.en: Illegal immigration is wrong, no matter how you look at it.
sentences.zh: 无论你怎么看，非法移民都是错误的。

sentences.en: People have to leave the country.
sentences.zh: 人们必须离开这个国家。

sentences.en: You know, whatever they say, we're going to get rid of the illegals and we're going to close the border.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，无论他们怎么说，我们要清除非法移民，我们要关闭边境。

sentences.en: Nobody ever says exactly what that's going to look like.
sentences.zh: 从来没有人确切说明那会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Or let's say making barbecue, for instance.
sentences.zh: 或者举个例子，比如说做烧烤。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Do you like barbecue pork?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢烤猪肉吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，喜欢。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You may not like watching how it's made.
sentences.zh: 你可能不喜欢看它是怎么做出来的。

sentences.en: So that's my point.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我的观点。

sentences.en: It's that it could be ugly.
sentences.zh: 那就是它可能会很丑陋。

sentences.en: It could be ugly.
sentences.zh: 过程可能会很难看。

sentences.en: After the break, we hear from one of those Trump voters who thinks that the president's deportation effort should go even further.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我们将倾听一位特朗普选民的心声，他认为总统的驱逐力度还应该更进一步。

sentences.en: And why, for this voter, that feeling runs so deeply.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么对这位选民来说，这种感受会如此深刻。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写“连连看”（Connections）游戏，这是《纽约时报》字谜游戏之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作“拼字蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）和“字母包厢”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“色听”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 加上斜杠 games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Can you tell me a little bit about yourself, your name, where you live, what you do?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我谈谈你自己吗，你的名字，你住在哪里，你是做什么工作的？

sentences.en: My name is John.
sentences.zh: 我叫约翰。

sentences.en: I'm 53 years old.
sentences.zh: 我今年53岁。

sentences.en: I'm a Mason.
sentences.zh: 我是一名泥瓦匠。

sentences.en: I live in Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 我住在马萨诸塞州。

sentences.en: I've been in the construction industry my whole life.
sentences.zh: 我一生都在建筑行业工作。

sentences.en: And I own a very small company.
sentences.zh: 我拥有一家非常小的公司。

sentences.en: I have a wife, two kids.
sentences.zh: 我有妻子，两个孩子。

sentences.en: And that's me in a nutshell.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的大致情况。

sentences.en: I first connected with John Palema about three weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 我大约在三周前首次与约翰·帕莱马取得了联系。

sentences.en: He lives in Bolton, a rural town in central Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 他住在马萨诸塞州中部的一个乡村小镇博尔顿。

sentences.en: Is there a political party that you have historically identified with?
sentences.zh: 有没有哪个政党是你历来所认同的？

sentences.en: Initially, it would have been the Democratic Party when I was in high school and probably a few years after.
sentences.zh: 最初，我在高中时以及之后的几年里大概会认同民主党。

sentences.en: And then I generally kind of turned conservative and I voted for Trump in 2024.
sentences.zh: 然后我基本上就有点转向保守派了，并在2024年投给了特朗普。

sentences.en: And did you vote for him in 16?
sentences.zh: 你在16年投给他了吗？

sentences.en: You know, have you always felt like he's a politician that you've believed in?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你一直觉得他是个你信得过的政治家吗？

sentences.en: So in 2016, 2020 and 2024, I believe I was given the option and excuse my French.
sentences.zh: 所以在2016年、2020年和2024年，我想我当时的选择是——请原谅我的粗鲁。

sentences.en: I was given the option to eat shit or drink piss.
sentences.zh: 我当时的选择是吃屎还是喝尿。

sentences.en: And in all three cases, I drank piss.
sentences.zh: 而在所有这三次中，我都选择了喝尿。

sentences.en: So there's your answer.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是你的答案。

sentences.en: And in all three cases, I voted for Trump.
sentences.zh: 而在所有这三次中，我都投给了特朗普。

sentences.en: So that's how much passion I have for the man.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我对这个人的热情所在。

sentences.en: What were the most important issues to you when you cast your ballot in 2024?
sentences.zh: 你在2024年投出一票时，最重要的议题是什么？

sentences.en: Well, immigration was a major issue, but that has been an issue my whole entire life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，移民是个重大议题，但这在我的一生中一直都是个议题。

sentences.en: Can I ask why?
sentences.zh: 我能问问为什么吗？

sentences.en: Because of what I do.
sentences.zh: 因为我的工作性质。

sentences.en: To be kind of simple, I move mass with my body.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，我用我的身体移动重物。

sentences.en: I'm a laborer at the very root of what I do.
sentences.zh: 从我的本质工作来说我就是一个体力劳动者。

sentences.en: I move things, I pick things up, I put things down.
sentences.zh: 我搬运东西，我捡起东西，我放下东西。

sentences.en: And that kind of work has been compromised by illegal immigration greatly.
sentences.zh: 而这种工作受到了非法移民的严重冲击。

sentences.en: I got into construction purely as an accident.
sentences.zh: 我进入建筑行业纯属偶然。

sentences.en: I was sort of a juvenile delinquent a bit.
sentences.zh: 我以前有点像个少年犯。

sentences.en: And my cousin said, work for me in Nantucket for a landscape construction company.
sentences.zh: 然后我表哥说，来南塔克特为我的一家景观建筑公司工作吧。

sentences.en: And I went down there and I worked as a laborer.
sentences.zh: 然后我去了那里，做了一名体力工人。

sentences.en: And then as I did it, I, you know, I became a pretty good laborer.
sentences.zh: 后来在做的过程中，你知道的，我成了一个相当不错的工人。

sentences.en: Later, I worked for other companies and I was seeing people getting hired and getting paid a lot less than me.
sentences.zh: 后来，我为其他公司工作，我看到有人被雇用，拿到的薪水比我少得多。

sentences.en: And when I inquired about it, my boss would say, well, they're less expensive.
sentences.zh: 当我打听这件事时，我的老板会说，嗯，他们更便宜。

sentences.en: I don't have to pay workman's comp on them.
sentences.zh: 我不用为他们支付劳工赔偿保险。

sentences.en: I don't have to pay general liability insurance on them.
sentences.zh: 我不用为他们支付普通责任险。

sentences.en: If they get hurt, they'll go to the emergency room.
sentences.zh: 如果他们受伤了，他们会去急诊室。

sentences.en: No sweat off my back.
sentences.zh: 这对我没有什么影响。

sentences.en: And I was getting paid less and less because I was competing against people who were hired because it costs less to hire them or employ them.
sentences.zh: 而我拿到的钱越来越少，因为我在跟那些因为雇佣成本更低而被雇用的人竞争。

sentences.en: And that bothered me.
sentences.zh: 这让我很困扰。

sentences.en: And then when I became a mason and I started building, I found that I was competing with companies that did that practice.
sentences.zh: 后来当我成为一名泥瓦匠并开始搞建设时，我发现我在跟采用这种做法的公司竞争。

sentences.en: And I couldn't hire an illegal alien.
sentences.zh: 而我无法雇佣非法外国人。

sentences.en: It just didn't seem right.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就是不对劲。

sentences.en: It's illegal, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这是违法的。

sentences.en: But people are getting away with it.
sentences.zh: 但人们却一直在逃避惩罚。

sentences.en: And I'm competing against them.
sentences.zh: 而我在与他们竞争。

sentences.en: And you notice it by just simply seeing the crews that are going out there.
sentences.zh: 你只要看看那些出工的施工队就能注意到这一点。

sentences.en: And when you give a price to somebody to do work, you're not even close to the lowest or the mid-price.
sentences.zh: 当你给别人报价做活时，你的价格连最低价或中间价都算不上。

sentences.en: You're always the highest price.
sentences.zh: 你总是报价最高的那一个。

sentences.en: I'm never going to get a certain percentage of jobs.
sentences.zh: 我永远无法拿到一定比例的工作机会。

sentences.en: And then I can't increase my rate because it's an unfair marketplace.
sentences.zh: 然后我也无法提高我的费率，因为这是一个不公平的市场。

sentences.en: I like the idea of working for myself.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢为自己工作的感觉。

sentences.en: And I could do the work.
sentences.zh: 我能胜任这项工作。

sentences.en: And I was good at it.
sentences.zh: 而且我很擅长。

sentences.en: Getting to the point I'm getting older and it's harder to do, especially now I can't hire a laborer because I don't feel that I can give them a living wage.
sentences.zh: 说到这儿我年纪越来越大了，这工作也越来越难做，尤其是现在我雇不起小工，因为我觉得我给不了他们维持生计的工资。

sentences.en: So it's just me doing the work, which is beating me up quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 所以只有我一个人干活，这让我身体吃不消。

sentences.en: But I'm sorry, I stay in shape and I keep going.
sentences.zh: 但抱歉，我保持着体形，我还在继续坚持。

sentences.en: Did you feel under Biden that that problem was worse?
sentences.zh: 在拜登执政期间，你觉得这个问题更严重吗？

sentences.en: The problem of competition from immigrant labor?
sentences.zh: 来自移民劳工竞争的问题？

sentences.en: No, it's been steadily getting worse.
sentences.zh: 不，这个问题一直在稳步恶化。

sentences.en: What recently kind of narrowed down my thought process on that was what Trump did at the border his second term by immediately shutting it down, the border crossings.
sentences.zh: 最近让我对此的思考过程有所缩窄的是，特朗普在第二任期通过立即关闭边境所做的事情，也就是关闭边境过境点。

sentences.en: All the way back to when I started working, when it was Bush senior was president, we had illegal immigration probleMs.
sentences.zh: 一直追溯到我开始工作的时候，那是老布什当总统的时候，我们就已经有非法移民问题了。

sentences.en: It seems like every president had an opportunity to stop that flood of illegal immigrants going over the border.
sentences.zh: 似乎每一位总统都有机会阻止那股涌过边境的非法移民洪流。

sentences.en: And none of them, Democrat or Republican, did anything about it.
sentences.zh: 但无论民主党还是共和党，他们当中没有一个人采取任何行动。

sentences.en: And the fact that it could have been done so quickly, as we have seen, is a little alarming to me.
sentences.zh: 而正如我们所见，这件事本可以做得如此之快，这让我感到有点惊慌。

sentences.en: It makes me feel like I'm forgotten as an American worker.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得自己作为一个美国工人被遗忘了。

sentences.en: As a working class person, they talk about the working class in this country.
sentences.zh: 作为一个工薪阶层的人，他们谈论这个国家的工薪阶层。

sentences.en: They talk about the business owners in this country being the backbone of the country.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论这个国家的企业主是国家的脊梁。

sentences.en: In fact, I'm not uncompassionate to the people that are illegally here.

sentences.en: They are generally good people.
sentences.zh: 他们总体上都是好人。

sentences.en: And I think everyone can agree that they generally aren't violent.
sentences.zh: 我想大家都会同意，他们总体上并不暴力。

sentences.en: But this is where the compassion problem is, in my opinion.

sentences.en: Is there a point when you think it will be enough?

sentences.en: Like, what's the end goal that you think is right?

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，理想情况下，你会希望国内一个非法移民都没有。

sentences.zh: 我不认为这是可能的。

sentences.en: I don't know, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我也不确定。

sentences.en: And unfortunately, we're at the point where when we fix this, it's going to cost money.

sentences.en: I mean, you're going to have to pay more to get your lawn cut, your roof done.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你得花更多的钱去修剪草坪、修理屋顶。

sentences.en: And you should pay more.
sentences.zh: 而且你应该付更多的钱。

sentences.en: Because that's how much the job takes.
sentences.zh: 因为这项工作本身就值这个价。

sentences.en: And that's how much these people who do this job should make.
sentences.zh: 从事这项工作的人也应该赚到这么多钱。

sentences.en: They should make a living to earn that American dream.

sentences.en: citizen in Minnesota in less than a month.

sentences.zh: 我只知道那里可能存在一些过失。

sentences.en: So there's faults with the video not kind of showing that, but I don't know if you can get the whole story out of that video.

sentences.en: I certainly didn't.
sentences.zh: 我肯定没有。

sentences.en: I know that a person died, and that's wrong.
sentences.zh: 我知道有人死了，那是错的。

sentences.en: And I know officers felt threatened, and that's wrong.
sentences.zh: 我也知道警官们感到了威胁，这也是不对的。

sentences.en: However, what bothered me most about the whole thing is that in 2025, there were people that died by the hands of illegal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 然而，整件事中最让我困扰的是，在2025年，有人死于非法移民之手。

sentences.en: I just looked it up quickly, and some of them were pretty bad.
sentences.zh: 我快速查了一下，其中一些情况相当严重。

sentences.en: And I put their names on the Google to see if I could find news stories about them.
sentences.zh: 我把他们的名字输入谷歌，看看能不能找到关于他们的报道。

sentences.en: And I particularly went to the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我特意去了《纽约时报》网站。

sentences.en: And there's no news on the first people I put in, not one news article.
sentences.zh: 我输入的前几个人根本没有相关新闻，连一篇报道都没有。

sentences.en: Yet on this man that got shot by the Border Patrol, there's 18.
sentences.zh: 然而对于这个被边境巡逻队枪杀的人，却有18篇。

sentences.en: I stopped counting at 18.
sentences.zh: 我数到18篇就没再数了。

sentences.en: But there was a boy that got killed by an illegal immigrant when he was helping his mother or stopping her from getting raped.
sentences.zh: 但曾有一个男孩在帮母亲或阻止母亲被强暴时被非法移民杀害。

sentences.en: Just 20, 25.
No report from the New York Times.

sentences.en: And it's just, there's a moral kind of compass there that I think has been loSt.

sentences.en: So that bothers me, like, a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很让我困扰。

sentences.en: John told me he was also frustrated that local law enforcement wasn't helping federal immigration officials carry out the deportations.
sentences.zh: 约翰还告诉我，他同样感到沮丧的是，当地执法部门没有协助联邦移民官员执行驱逐任务。

sentences.en: That ideally, they'd be working together as a team.
sentences.zh: 理想情况下，他们应该像团队一样协同工作。

sentences.en: But despite these challenges, despite the death of two American citizens, despite the protests, John still wanted the Trump administration to stay the course in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 但尽管面临这些挑战，尽管有两名美国公民死亡，尽管爆发了抗议活动，约翰仍然希望特朗普政府在明尼苏达州坚持既定路线。

sentences.en: Just because the job isn't working doesn't mean you stop doing the job.
sentences.zh: 工作行不通并不意味着你就不干了。

sentences.en: I believe in people's civil rights and their right to proteSt.
sentences.zh: 我信仰人们的公民权利以及他们抗议的权利。

sentences.zh: 当抗议活动阻止联邦特工执行公务时，这就不再是抗议了。

sentences.zh: 你知道的，言论自由修正案意味着你可以畅所欲言，但你不能在拥挤的电影院里大喊失火。

sentences.en: You can't take it to that extreme.
sentences.zh: 你不能走向那个极端。

sentences.en: You can be on the sidelines in proteSt.
sentences.zh: 你可以在场外进行抗议。

sentences.en: And the state and local government should be there making sure the protest is not getting involved with the federal officers.
sentences.zh: 州和地方政府应该在那里确保抗议活动不与联邦特工发生冲突。

sentences.en: And they can protest and they have every right to, and they should, if they don't feel this is right, they should proteSt.
sentences.zh: 他们可以抗议，他们完全有权抗议，如果他们觉得这不对，他们就应该抗议。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: But they should not get involved in the operations of federal agents going after illegal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 但他们不应卷入联邦特工追捕非法移民的行动中。

sentences.en: That was a course of action that was mandated by the people of this country.
sentences.zh: 那是这个国家的人民所授权的行动方针。

sentences.en: Is there a point at which the cost becomes too much, the cost of pursuing this goal of deporting people in the country illegally?
sentences.zh: 有没有这样一个时刻，代价变得过于高昂，即追求驱逐境内非法移民这一目标的代价？

sentences.zh: 但这里受伤害的人，是那些卷入本质上具有风险、暴力的行动中的人。

sentences.en: It involves weapons.

sentences.en: If someone puts themselves in a situation like that, they're going to have issues.
sentences.zh: 如果有人让自己陷入那样的境地，就会出问题。

sentences.en: Just stay home.

sentences.en: Let the government do the job that your previous government got them into.

sentences.en: It's not like Trump brought these illegal immigrants into these areas just so he could kill American citizens.
sentences.zh: 特朗普又不是把这些非法移民带到这些地区来，纯粹为了杀害美国公民。

sentences.en: I mean, that's what it sounds like if you read the newspapers.

sentences.en: It sounds like Trump started all this and his border patrol started this.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是特朗普挑起了这一切，他的边境巡逻队挑起了这一切。

sentences.en: Well, if everyone just stayed home and let them do their jobs, there would be no deaths.
